answer: At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a dawn tag. The island cap is applied at intake and umber shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, as each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The deposit is 58 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
